body:
Make planning runs cheaper when they read worker runs and look up worker commands.

## 1. A step read doesn't repeat the run
`strategy show run <task> <run> <steps>` repeats the whole run header with every request: the `reads` symbol list, and each question with its full settings `base` and `proposed` text. In run dbff066ccf7c1e27 that was about 15,000 tokens per call, for steps of a few hundred. When steps are asked for, the reply should give only a one-line run header (id, kind, model, outcome) and the steps. The full header stays in the reply that has no step list.

## 2. List only the failed steps
Add `strategy show run <task> <run> --failed`. It gives one line per failed tool step: its number, the head of its command, and the first line of its error, such as `E0108 …` or `E6002 …`. The one-line step list today shows only "(failed)" and a cut title.

## 3. Worker docs for planners
- `help <command>` in a strategy run refuses worker commands: `help submit` gives "No command `submit`". It should show the command's reference section, marked as a worker command a strategy run can't run.
- The `help` reply's command list is malformed: `strategy, feature, milestone>, all], milestone, files, read, --tail`. Fix how it's built.
- The strategy brief says `grep` has "no options, regex or path filter". But `grep` takes `--in <path>` and `--context n`, and says so itself. Make the brief match.

## Done when
- `board::tests.strategy_show_run_outlines_and_picks_steps`, or a new test, covers 1 and 2.
- `help` and the brief are pinned by tests.
- Spec 15 §6 (strategy run) is updated.

Out of scope: finding text inside symbol-held source with `grep`, which uses `find` today, and a larger match cap for `grep`.
title: strategy runs: cheaper run reads, worker docs
